possible_duplicates.reason: Same root cause and same request: under `uv sync --frozen`, index/mirror configuration (here UV_DEFAULT_INDEX) is ignored and installs use the URLs recorded in uv.lock. Issue is closed as completed; resolution not verified beyond the search excerpt.

related_issues.reason: Open enhancement (needs-design) asking for uv.lock to support different index URLs across developer machines and CI, which is the broader design question behind wanting a mirror override honored with a lockfile.

rationale: Under --frozen uv performs no resolution and installs from the lockfile as-is, so UV_INDEX_STRATEGY has nothing to act on and UV_DEFAULT_INDEX is not applied to locked source URLs. This is consistent with uv's design (the lock records its index URLs) and the docs (indexes.md) define UV_INDEX_STRATEGY only as a resolution setting, so there is no documented contract that --frozen honors index env vars; the reporter's wish that it should is a behaviour change, hence enhancement rather than the reporter's bug label. The report includes the Dockerfile, command, uv version (0.12.15) and platform, so a maintainer can reproduce it without asking. Closest prior issue is 19625 (same symptom and request, closed); I did not confirm its resolution, so confidence is medium.
